objective.name: active_wait_result
objective.description: Defines the structured wait result injected into the next pilot inference when a previously active wait group becomes satisfied. It says only that the wait ended and how many answers it holds: the answers themselves are in the conversation, each with the id of its intention.

functional._wait_group_id_note: Required. Identifier of the wait group that ended. It makes each resumption a different text: pilot.infer memoizes a step by the text of its prompt, and two waits that ended alike must not be taken for one.
functional._outcome_note: Required. Overall wait outcome. no_success is used when a first_success group resolves because all expected results ended in error.
functional._received_note: Required. Number of answers received by the wait group when it became satisfied.
functional._expected_note: Required. Number of answers the wait group expected.
